title: Every PR edited the two shared ledger files, so each merge conflicted every other open PR and merges ran one at a time; ledger changes are now fragment files a loader merges

source.ref: owner, 2026-09-29 ~19:50Z: "Change the rule or something. I don't want stuff like this jamming me up."

detail:
FILED AND CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1635). MEASURED FAILURE: every PR closed its row and pruned it from a meta.slate wave in docs/BUILD-BACKLOG.json and appended its ADR to docs/DECISIONS.md, so each merge conflicted every other open PR on those two files and nothing else; about twenty finished PRs queued behind one-at-a-time folds on 2026-09-29.

WHAT CLOSED IT. scripts/lib/ledger.mjs merges docs/ledger/rows/<ID>.json (a full new row, or {id, patch, append, wave}) and docs/ledger/adr/ADR-<n>.md into the base files, deterministically, and drops done and parked ids from every wave at load time. check:backlog (both probe arms), check:adr, check:id-collisions (fragment ids from PR file names), check:shipped-ids, pnpm backlog and pnpm packets read the merged view; check:one-list keeps docs/ledger fragments-only; check:docs-links resolves an ADR fragment's links from docs/. validateSlateWaves keeps its token arm only. pnpm ledger:from-diff converts a branch's direct edits into fragments and restores the two files to main (owner ruling: convert, then parallel); pnpm ledger:view prints the merged view. PROG-D5, PROG-D6, DEF-HARDEN and HYG-047 probes read the merged view. This row and ADR-1635 are the first fragments.

DEFERRED to a follow-up row (orchestrator ruling 2026-09-29): pnpm ledger:compact (the tool; the notice past 30 fragments ships here), the ledger:close/add/adr helpers, and re-pointing the remaining probes that parse the JSON directly (PROG-D7, PROG-R10, LIVE-034, HYG-108, LIVE-176, HYG-023, LIVE-447, LIVE-478, HYG-124).

verify.note: Measures the consequence in a fixture: an open row whose grep-present probe passes fails check:backlog (the stale-open arm), and the same tree plus one fragment closing it passes, so the guard judges the merged view; the loaded view applies the patch and the append and takes the done row off its wave. Then this tree: HYG-145 and ADR-1635 are visible through the loader. Fails on main (scripts/lib/ledger.mjs does not exist there).
